notes.title: Patch 9/22/2019
notes.notes:
A few days ago, the game was updated with a patch to fix some issues regarding a puzzle in the second dungeon. I also took the time to add an additional secret area as a result of some feedback during a stream. It's somewhere in the first dungeon. 

That's all really! Nothing big! 

Thanks for playing as usual.

- MirageV

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33596358/2fd209a156acad12758222276a541da193f7dd2d.png

It's out! 

The full game has been released. I've been playtesting the features and making sure that nothing explodes right up until the 11th hour, but the time has finally come to hit the release button. Sacred Earth - Promise is officially out. 

Thanks to everyone for their support and encouragement. And I hope that people just have fun with it!

Thanks again.
